integrity: The proof uses exact boundary-law algebra, an exact transition matrix, exact eigenvalue reductions, sign factorizations, and monotonicity on the full continuous domains. The numerical decimal for the algebraic root is display-only, and the bundled verifier is supplementary rather than an infinite-domain certificate.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the Kesten–Stigum sufficient non-extremality test; failure of the test is not a proof of extremality.
The theorem is specialized to the homogeneous zero-field three-state Potts model on the Cayley tree of order four.
A weakly indexed equivalent calculation under different boundary-law notation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Kesten–Stigum boundary for nontrivial three-state Potts phases on the order-four Cayley tree
